name: RLS Global AB (publ)
summary: RLS Global AB (publ), a medical technology company, develops and sells products for the treatment of diseases in wound and dental care in Sweden. Its products include ChloraSolv that is used for the treatment of chronic foot and leg ulcers for diabetic patients; and CariSolv, a gel used for treating caries. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Mölndal, Sweden.
